title: Broker rate is to a USD base, not NZD (chained conversion)
description: A USD-based Tiger account buys 100 HK-listed shares for HKD 80,000, with a broker rate of 0.1250 that converts HKD to the account's USD base (giving USD 10,000) — NOT to NZD. The correct NZD cost chains both legs: HKD 80,000 x 0.1250 = USD 10,000, then / 0.6000 = NZD 16,666.67. Naively treating 0.1250 as an NZD rate gives a nonsense NZD 640,000. Spec §5.7 calls this the single most damaging silent failure in the product.
